description: Partner detail navigation interface with tabs for different aspects of partner information. Provides organized access to partner details, contacts, interactions, funding agreements, and analytics data.

pages.name: PartnerTabsComponent
pages.description: This page serves as the central hub for viewing and managing all information related to a specific partner. It organizes various aspects of partner data into distinct tabs, allowing users to easily navigate between details, contacts, interactions, funding agreements, and performance analytics. The partner's logo and basic identifying information are consistently displayed at the top for quick reference.

help_guidance.when_stuck: If you're looking for specific partner information, use the tabs at the top of the page to navigate between different sections. The partner's logo and essential details are always visible at the top, regardless of which tab you're on. Each tab provides a focused view, such as organizational details, associated contacts, historical interactions, financial agreements, or performance dashboards.
common_tasks: Viewing partner details: Click on the 'Details' tab to see the main organizational information.
Managing contacts: Switch to the 'Contacts' tab to view, add, or edit individuals associated with this partner.
Checking interactions: Navigate to the 'Interactions' tab to review past communications and activities with the partner.
Viewing funding: Go to the 'Funding & Agreements' tab for financial information and contractual details.
Accessing analytics: Use the 'Dashboard' tab to view performance metrics and analytical data related to the partner.
Uploading logo: Click on the existing logo or the designated logo area to upload a new partner logo image.
help_guidance.getting_started: To begin, select a partner from the main partners list. This page will then load, displaying the 'Details' tab by default. From here, you can explore all aspects of the partner's profile by clicking on the various tabs available.
